name: Seated Cable Fly
cues: Set the pulleys at shoulder height with an upright bench between them
Sit tall with your back against the pad
Keep your elbows softly bent as you sweep the handles together
Let your arms open slowly until they line up with your torso

qa.note: Wave 3a 2026-10-08: rated minor, owner review. minor: The hands stay at y 1.13 m through the whole rep: 7 cm above the shoulder joint (1.06) and 20 cm above the sternum (0.93), with the upper arm at 91 deg to the trunk. They meet at collarbone level, while 129 meets at the sternum and the pec deck 110 meets 13 cm below the shoulder. The pulley sits at shoulder height (1.04) as the cue says. Tower tops are slightly cropped.
